relevance.rationale: Identifies 998 closed hyperbolic 3-manifolds whose volumes are rational multiples of a normalised Dedekind zeta value at 2 for the invariant trace field, tabulates the rational invariant a/b for cusped single-complex-place manifolds complementary to knots and links (within and beyond the standard censuses), and exhibits explicit links realising the fields distinguished by these relations. The corpus's appendix-surreals chapter runs the volume-to-regulator correspondence at depth 2 and 3 (prop:borel-partial-resolution: the Bloch-Wigner regulator image is the Q-line spanned by the figure-eight volume; the depth-3 Q(zeta_5) row), which is the same arithmetic phenomenon in K-theoretic dress. This paper is the numerical, census-scale face of it and supplies concrete cross-check data. Supporting, not core: the corpus derives its depth-2/3 statements from Borel and Bloch-Suslin, not from these tables. The authors themselves note the results are numerically secure but hard to prove analytically -- so anything drawn from them is a cross-check, never a value to adopt.

keyResults.locator: abstract (the a/b formula) + the census tables
keyResults.statement: For a hyperbolic 3-manifold whose invariant trace field has a single complex place, the volume equals a rational multiple a/b of a normalised Dedekind zeta value at 2 for that field; 152 distinct such zeta values are identified across the censuses, with 91 manifolds having volumes reducible to pairs of them.
keyResults.useForFolio: A published table of volume-to-zeta rational invariants to cross-check the corpus's link/knot volume computations and the Bring-natural number fields of the depth correspondence against.

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry; the corpus's volume-regulator chapter cites bloch2000 and suslin1991 but has no source for the explicit numerical volume-to-Dedekind-zeta correspondence.

Cross-check the corpus's computed link/knot hyperbolic volumes against the published a/b rational invariants for the same complements. This is a cross-check only: any agreement corroborates, and no external number may be adopted into a witness on the strength of a match.
